tools.name: set_workspace
tools.description: Bind the daemon to a workspace directory. Must be called before any other tool. CLI: `engram bind [path]`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_daemon_status
tools.description: Return runtime metrics for the running daemon (version, uptime, memory, connections). CLI: `engram daemon-status`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_workspace_status
tools.description: Return the current workspace status including code graph statistics, stale files, and connection info. CLI: `engram workspace-status`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: flush_state
tools.description: Persist in-memory workspace state to disk (.engram/ files). Safe to call at any time. CLI: `engram flush`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: query_memory
tools.description: Search workspace context records (decisions, notes) using a natural language query. CLI: `engram query-memory`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_workspace_statistics
tools.description: Return aggregate statistics for the workspace: task counts by status, label distribution, and more. CLI: `engram stats`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: index_workspace
tools.description: Parse and index the workspace source files into the code graph. Run once after `set_workspace`. CLI: `engram index`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: sync_workspace
tools.description: Incrementally synchronize changed source files into the code graph since the last index. CLI: `engram sync`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: map_code
tools.description: Return the call graph and usages for a named symbol up to a configurable depth. CLI: `engram map-code`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List symbols (functions, structs, enums, etc.) indexed in the code graph, with optional filters. CLI: `engram symbols`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: unified_search
tools.description: Search across tasks, context records, and code symbols using a single natural language query. CLI: `engram search`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: impact_analysis
tools.description: Analyze impact over the code call graph by symbol_name or the Power BI dependency graph by powerbi_node_id. CLI: `engram impact`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: lint_dax
tools.description: Lint the DAX in the bound workspace's indexed Power BI model(s), returning { conformant, findings[] }. Applies Tier-1 syntactic rules and Tier-2 schema-aware rules (broken column/measure refs, unqualified-column and qualified-measure style findings, and measure-to-measure cycles) by reparsing measure and calculated-column expressions against the model-scope-aggregated schema. CLI: `engram lint-dax`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_health_report
tools.description: Return runtime health metrics for the daemon including memory usage, tool call counts, event processing statistics, and query latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99). CLI: `engram health`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_branch_metrics
tools.description: Return the persisted metrics summary for a branch, or compare two branches. CLI: `engram branch-metrics`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_token_savings_report
tools.description: Return a concise text summary of the current branch's tracked token delivery. CLI: `engram report token-savings`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_evaluation_report
tools.description: Compute an agent efficiency evaluation report from recorded usage events. Returns per-agent scoring, anomaly flags (token ratio spikes, error bursts, tool hammering), and actionable recommendations. CLI: `engram report eval`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: run_retrieval_eval
tools.description: Run the portable retrieval + graph-recall evaluation over the indexed workspace. Derives ground truth automatically (semantic self-retrieval from indexed function docstrings, falling back to the function name; graph resolution recall from the parser call-site inventory) and returns a structured RetrievalEvalReport with semantic (precision@k, recall@k, MRR, nDCG) and graph (resolution_recall, false_edge_rate) metrics. Evaluates functions only — not arbitrary symbols or qualified-name uniqueness. Disabled by default; returns an empty report unless enabled via the [retrieval_eval] config section. Distinct from get_evaluation_report (agent efficiency). CLI: `engram eval`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_retrieval_eval_report
tools.description: Return the latest persisted retrieval + graph-recall evaluation report (RetrievalEvalReport) for the current branch, or a well-formed empty report when no run exists. Distinct from get_evaluation_report (agent efficiency). MCP-only daemon surface. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: query_graph
tools.description: Execute a structured graph query against the workspace code and backlog graph. Three operations are supported: `neighborhood` (BFS from a root node), `find_path` (shortest path between two nodes), and `transitive_closure` (all nodes reachable from a root). Edge types: code (`calls`, `imports`, `defines`, `inherits_from`, `concerns`, `references`), backlog (`parent_of`, `depends_on`, `backlog_references`), powerbi (`pbi_contains`, `pbi_uses_field`, `pbi_depends_on_model`, `pbi_belongs_to_report`, `pbi_relates_to_table`), and lineage (`lineage_derives_from`, oriented target→source: an outgoing traversal from a target reaches its upstream sources, an incoming traversal from a source reaches its downstream consumers). Results are capped at 500 nodes. CLI: `engram query-graph`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md

tools.name: get_mutable_script_retry_metrics
tools.description: Return mutable-script SQLITE_BUSY retry telemetry: monotonic retry count and timestamp of the most recent retry. Does not require a workspace to be bound. CLI: `engram report retry-metrics`. See https://github.com/softwaresalt/agent-engram/blob/main/docs/cli-mcp-parity.md
